doa.definition:
n. Lady; mistress; madam; -- a title of respect used in Spain,
   prefixed to the Christian name of a lady.

doab.definition:
A tongue or tract of land included between two rivers; as, the
   doab between the Ganges and the Jumna.

doable.definition: s capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
doable.translation: a. 可做的, 切实可行的

doabs.definition:
plural of doab
 A tongue or tract of land included between two rivers; as, the
   doab between the Ganges and the Jumna.
doabs.translation: (doab 的复数) 河间冲积地(印度)

doan.translation: abbr. N, N-diocthlaniline N,N-二辛基苯胺（科技符号）

doane.translation: [男子名] 多恩来源于古英语，含义是“山坡”(hill slope)

doany.translation: [地名] [马达加斯加] 杜阿尼
